description: This file defines the TemplateHelper class in the OrangeHRM system, which facilitates rendering Twig templates from strings with a provided context. It encapsulates twig environment setup and provides a method to render templates with error handling.

classes.name: TemplateHelper
classes.description: A helper class for rendering Twig templates from strings with specified context, encapsulating Twig environment setup.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Twig Environment with an ArrayLoader.

methods.name: getTwig
methods.description: Returns the Twig Environment instance used for rendering templates.

methods.name: renderTemplate
methods.description: Renders a provided Twig template string with optional context, throwing a custom exception on failure.
